END total ,Balance ,Year(com.fecha) Año ,month(Com.fecha) Mes ,case when pagada = 1 then 'SI' else 'NO 'end Pagada FROM [UniFacturaDigitalUV]..[Comprobante] Com inner join OzUnivisit..Empresas e on com.idEmpresa = e.idEmpresa WHERE [activo] = 1 AND [incobrable] = 0 ) r left join (
Select com.[Comprobante_Id] ,TotalMxn Ingreso FROM [UniFacturaDigitalUV]..[Comprobante] com INNER JOIN [UniFacturaDigitalUV]..[Conceptos] cs ON com.[Comprobante_Id] = cs.[Comprobante_Id] INNER JOIN [UniFacturaDigitalUV]..[Concepto] c ON cs.[Conceptos_Id] = c.[Conceptos_Id] INNER JOIN ( SELECT BRC.[InvoiceItemID], (CD.ReservationFare * Rc.[MoneyExchangeRateMxn]) AS TotalMxn FROM HotelBillingSystemUV..[ReservationCharges] RC INNER JOIN ( SELECT [ReservationChargeID],SUM((ReservationFare)) ReservationFare FROM HotelBillingSystemUV..[CommissionDetails] WHERE STATUS in (0,1,2,5) GROUP BY [ReservationChargeID] ) AS CD ON RC.[ReservationChargeID] = CD.[ReservationChargeID] INNER JOIN HotelBillingSystemUV..[BilledReservationCharges] BRC ON CD.[ReservationChargeID] = BRC.[ReservationChargeID] )i on i.[InvoiceItemID] = c.[Concepto_Id] Group by com.[Comprobante_Id],TotalMxn ) i on r.[Comprobante_Id] = i.[Comprobante_Id]
Order by Nombre,año,mes

Declare @Ini char(10) Declare @Fin char(10)

Select E.IdEmpresa ,E.Nombre Empresa ,R.Nombre Rubro ,ISNULL(Bill_RazonSocial,'S/R') RazonSocial ,Serie + '-' + Folio Factura ,'Cancelada' Estado ,FechaCancelacion

Declare @Ini char(10) Declare @Fin char(10)
Set @Ini = '@@@param1' Set @Fin = '@@@param2'
Select E.IdEmpresa ,E.Nombre Empresa ,R.Nombre Rubro ,ISNULL(Bill_RazonSocial,'S/R') RazonSocial ,Serie + '-' + Folio Factura ,'Incobrable' Estado ,c.fecha [Fecha la Factura] ,fechaIncobrable [Fecha en que se mando a Incobrable]
from UniFacturaDigitalUv..Comprobante C inner join OzUnivisit..Empresas E on E.idEmpresa = C.idEmpresa inner join OzUnivisit..Rubros R on R.idRubro = E.idRubro Where Incobrable = 1 AND Convert(char(10),c.fecha,111) >= @Ini AND Convert(char(10),c.fecha,111) <= @Fin ORder by c.fecha
